title: Bumrah bola HIGH hai... phir bhi REVIEW kyun?
voice: ElevenLabs Bunty – Punchy, Crisp and Reel King (website, Eleven v4)
lines: [excited] Bumrah bola, HIGH hai... par Gill ne review le liya!
Review gaya... Blundell ne fifty maari.
Not out ke baad ghadi chalu... sirf 15 second!
Bowler, keeper salaah dete... faisla sirf captain ka.
Aise aur raaz ke liye... follow karo!
caption:
Bumrah ne khud bola ki ball pad pe HIGH lagi hai... phir bhi aakhri second pe review liya gaya, aur review gaya. 🏏 Christchurch Test, Day 1: Blundell bach gaye aur stumps tak 53* bana diye.

DRS review ka raaz:
• Umpire ke faisle ke baad team ke paas sirf 15 second hote hain. Usi me haathon se "T" banana padta hai.
• Not out pe review sirf fielding captain maang sakta hai. Bowler aur keeper aam taur pe salaah dete hain, par faisla captain ka.
• Review galat nikla toh us innings ka ek review kam. Sirf LBW pe "umpire's call" aaye toh review bach jaata hai.

Tumhe kya lagta hai: captain ko bowler ki sunni chahiye ya apni? Comment karo 👇
